name: Burning Blood (quest item)
summary: In Duskwood, Burning Blood is gathered from the Nightbane worgen. Grimand Elmore needs twenty vials for experiments in smithing.

sections.title: A Volatile Reagent
sections.body: Nightbane worgen prowl Duskwood with a strange fury, and their blood burns with real heat. The fluid can be drawn from worgen haunting the timberlands and Roland's Doom. Though foul to gather, its heat draws the interest of armorers seeking to temper resilient plate.

sections.title: Elmore's Experiment
sections.body: Grimand Elmore works as an armorer in Stormwind's Dwarven District. He wants to test smithing methods developed by his former student Furen Longbeard. For the experiment, Elmore needs Burning Blood and a dense burning rock held by the worgen chieftain Gutspill. Those who bring back the bubbling fluid are promised sturdy warrior armor from his forge.

faq.answer: Burning Blood is a hot bodily fluid taken from Nightbane worgen in Duskwood. Grimand Elmore needs it for smithing experiments.

faq.q: Where does Burning Blood come from?
faq.answer: Burning Blood comes from Nightbane worgen in Duskwood, especially those around Roland's Doom.

faq.q: Why does Grimand Elmore need it?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore needs Burning Blood to test smithing methods developed by Furen Longbeard. With a burning rock, he plans to forge protective mail for a warrior.

faq.q: Why is the blood of the Nightbane burning?
aliases: why do worgen have burning blood
faq.answer: Nightbane are unnatural fiends summoned by dark, chaotic magic. The curse in their blood gives it a fierce, unnatural heat.

angles.text: Grimand Elmore uses Burning Blood to test smithing methods and promises durable plate armor to warriors who bring it to him.
Smiths can use unusual materials like burning worgen blood to quench and temper heavy metals at extreme heat.
